chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Saqr the goldsmith of Ray narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Abbas ibn Basam narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn Khalid ibn Ibrahim narrated to me, saying: Isma'il ibn Musa al-Thaqafi informed me, saying: Abdullah ibn Muhammad informed me, from his father, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir, from his father, from his grandfather (peace be upon them all).

He said: Ali (peace be upon him) said: I had ten characteristics from the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family): Each of which would please me more than everything upon which the sun shines and sets. Some of his companions said to him: Explain them to us, O Ali. He (peace be upon him) said: I heard the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) say: O Ali! You are the Trustee, and you are the Vizier, and you are the Caliph over the Household and the Property, and your friend is my friend, and your enemy is my enemy, and you are the master of the Muslims after me, and you are my brother, and you are the closest of creatures to me at the Standing [on Judgment Day], and you are the bearer of my banner in this world and the Hereafter.
ai.seo_question: What are the ten characteristics of Ali ibn Abi Talib from the Prophet Muhammad according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *al-Khisal*, this narration highlights the ten distinct virtues Ali ibn Abi Talib received from the Prophet, emphasizing his dual role as both spiritual and temporal successor (*Khalifah*) and his unique closeness to the Prophet in the Hereafter. The hadith underscores the Shia doctrine of *Nass* (divine designation) by explicitly linking Ali’s authority over the community and the Prophet’s household to direct prophetic declaration, reinforcing his status as the first Imam.
